news.title: Prozone Realty Limited (BSE:534675) agreed to acquire of remaining share 38.50% stake in Hagwood Commercial Developers Private Limited from Pearlscope Limited and Triangle Real Estate India Investments Limited for INR 514 Million.
news.body:
Prozone Realty Limited (BSE:534675) agreed to acquire of remaining share 38.50% stake in Hagwood Commercial Developers Private Limited from Pearlscope Limited and Triangle Real Estate India Investments Limited for INR 514 Million on March 16, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 514 million will be paid by Prozone Realty Limited (BSE:534675).As part of consideration, INR 514 million is paid towards common equity of Hagwood Commercial Developers Private Limited. Upon completion, Prozone Realty Limited will own 100% stake in Hagwood Commercial Developers Private Limited.

For the period ending December 31, 2025, Hagwood Commercial Developers Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 544 million.

The expected completion of the transaction is April 30, 2026.
